style.backgroundSystem: warm ivory field #F7E9EA for benefit, pain and trust pages; matte blush limewash wall #F0CFD6 for the botanical and variant pages; one deep rosewood field #8E3B52 for the macro and closing screens; a honed rose-travertine shelf #EDE0DA as the recurring physical plinth; never water, ripples, grids, mirror plate or glass dishes
style.direction: premium warm-rose botanical facial essence water commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin rosewood #8E3B52 outline glyphs drawn inside hexagon frames and small diamond tiles; no circle chips, no node rails, no pills, no oversized or ghost numerals, no metallic or gradient type
style.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light around 5200K, one large soft front key with a warm fill card, low-contrast soft single-direction contact shadows, one thin specular travelling only down the frosted glass, consistent single light direction on every screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium warm-rose botanical skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory ground #F7E9EA, blush petal field #F0CFD6, deep rosewood text and accent #8E3B52 and one sage-leaf secondary #7C8B6B; warm high-key studio light around 5200K with a large soft front key and a warm fill card, low-contrast soft contact shadows, one thin specular only on the frosted glass; modern geometric humanist sans-serif; single-weight thin rosewood outline icons inside hexagon frames and small diamond tiles; a matte blush limewash wall with a honed rose-travertine shelf, fresh-cut garden rose blooms and loose matte petals laid flat, never water, ripples, bubbles, grids, mirror plates, pearls or glass dishes; stable upright product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes away from the warm rose set
no water, ripples, bubbles, frozen splash or glass dishes introduced
no grids, laser lines, mirror plates or drafting-paper ruling
no inconsistent lighting or mismatched icon styles
style.presentationRules: stable upright product angle and scale for the frosted bottle, product never clipped, label facing camera on the packshot, identical crop and light on comparison panels
style.surfaceSystem: honed matte rose-travertine shelf #EDE0DA and blush limewash ground, a folded blush silk ribbon swatch, fresh-cut garden rose blooms and loose matte petals laid flat; never pearls, never a glass watch-dish, never linen over stone, never paper with drafting ruling
style.typography: modern geometric humanist sans-serif; deep rosewood #8E3B52 headlines on warm ivory #F7E9EA, thin short centred rosewood hairline dividers rather than full-width bands; headline 30-42pt, subtitle 15-20pt, label 11-15pt; all rendered copy stays short and placeholder-driven
